recipients.subject: Remote workforce, incident response, cloud cost and secure access — practical IT services for Airbnb
recipients.body:
Hi Airbnb,

I noticed Airbnb. A few practical IT playbooks fit that tempo well:

Primary:
- Remote Workforce Enablement & Managed VDI — /services/it-remote-workforce-enablement
- Incident Response & Forensics Retainer — /services/it-incident-response-retainer
- Cloud Cost Optimization & FinOps — /services/it-cost-optimization-cloud

Related options:
- Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) Implementation — /services/it-secure-access-service-edge
- Modern Dev Platform / DevEx Accelerator — /services/it-modern-dev-platform
- Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) — /services/it-zero-trust-access

Want a quick call?

Best,
Zion Tech Group
